title: Free Skate Jam scheduled for Sept. 26 at Upcountry Skate Park in Pukalani
text:
Free Skate Jam scheduled for Sept. 26 at Upcountry Skate Park in Pukalani
U. N. Kim
The County of Maui Department of Parks and Recreation and One Love Skate announced on Sept. 16 that they will host a free Skate Jam event from 3 to 6 p.m. on Saturday, Sept. 26, at the Upcountry Skate Park in Pukalani.
Skaters of all ages and skill levels are invited to participate. Registration will begin at 2:45 p.m., with skate lessons offered from 3 to 3:30 p.m. The event will feature a variety of contests throughout the afternoon, including timed runs and best trick competitions.
Food, games, prizes, and music will be available for both participants and spectators during the event.
Helmets are required for all skaters attending the event. A limited amount of skateboarding equipment will be available for those who need to borrow it.
For more information about the event, individuals can contact One Love Skate President Josh Marburger via email. General information about County parks is available on the Maui County website.
